An Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA) is a time series model which can be used to describe a set of data. In particular,with Xₜ representing the series, the model assumes the data are of form (after differencing _diffOrder times): Xₜ = c + εₜ + ΣᵢφᵢXₜ₋ᵢ + Σᵢθᵢεₜ₋ᵢ where the first sum has an upper limit of _arOrder and the second _maOrder.

To view the implementation of this indicator, see the LEAN GitHub repository.
